messages.subject: issues running the "getting started" tutorial
parts:
Hi Mike and everyone,

I was trying to run the tutorial (https://mrke.github.io/getting_started/),
 but found some issues, that might be relevant reporting.

When runing the micro_aust in rstudio 1.4.1717 (pc) gives an error saying "malformed NETCDF" (see image attached). Also, the R output starts appearing in red and then it becomes apparently impossible to copy it out of r . Most strange is: i can ctually copy  the output  to an address barr in the browser, and then copy it here. Still, I  cannot copy it in here, nor to a word file.

Here is the full error  text, after passing through the chrome address bar

downloading DEM via package elevatr Accessing raster elevation [=========================] 100% Mosaicing & Projecting Note: Elevation units are in meters. If program is crashing, try run.gads = 2. running micro_global to get clear sky solar If program is crashing, try run.gads = 2. extracting climate data extracting soil moisture data running microclimate model for 365 days by 1 years at site long -89.4 lat 43.07 Note: the output column `SOLR` in metout and shadmet is for unshaded horizontal plane solar radiation runtime 0.670000000000073 seconds extracting climate data via opendap - note that there is no wind speed data, so the daily range is assumed to be from 0.5 to 2 m/s extracting climate data reading weather input for variable rad for year 2015 syntax error, unexpected $end, expecting SCAN_ATTR or SCAN_DATASET or SCAN_ERROR context: ^ Error in RNetCDF::open.nc(paste0(baseurl, var, "/day/", year, "/bom-",  : NetCDF: Malformed or inaccessible DAP DDS

Finally, during some of my attempts R started to stop executing some actions (e.g. getwd(), ectotherm...).

Thanks for all!
Agus
